description: 人工构造的开发验收样例，不是实测结果；reference 是一种可接受表达，semantic_checks 才是语义标准。不得用把字数或句长评分。

cases.source: The optimization reduced latency, but memory use did not change.
cases.reference_translation: 这项优化降低了延迟，但内存占用没有变化。
cases.reject_example: 这项优化把延迟降低了。内存占用没有变化。

cases.source: Please move the file to the archive folder after the upload finishes.
cases.reference_translation: 上传完成后，请把文件移到归档文件夹。
semantic_checks: 完成上传是移动文件的前提

cases.source: Set the batch size to 32, then rerun the test.
cases.reference_translation: 先把批大小调到 32，再重新运行测试。
semantic_checks: 保留操作结果与先后关系

cases.source: The scheduler assigns each request to an idle worker.
cases.reference_translation: 调度器为每个请求分配一个空闲工作进程。

cases.source: If bandwidth stays unchanged, adding GPUs may not improve throughput.
cases.reference_translation: 如果带宽不变，增加 GPU 数量也未必能提高吞吐量。

cases.source: Do not retry unless the failure is transient.
cases.reference_translation: 只有暂时性故障才应重试。
semantic_checks: 不改成所有失败都重试

cases.source: Despite the delay, demand remained strong.
cases.reference_translation: 尽管交付延期，需求依然强劲。

cases.source: The design is faster, but it uses more memory.
cases.reference_translation: 这种设计速度更快，但内存占用也更高。
semantic_checks: 转折不能因删连接词丢失

cases.source: The system reuses cached results to avoid repeated computation. This reduces latency, but the benefit depends on the hit rate.
cases.reference_translation: 系统通过复用缓存结果避免重复计算，从而降低延迟；但收益取决于缓存命中率。
semantic_checks: 复用与计算和延迟关系完整
可合并关系紧密的短句

cases.source: One team reduced memory use. Another team improved observability.
cases.reference_translation: 一支团队降低了内存占用，另一支团队则改善了可观测性。
semantic_checks: 不把两支团队混成一个

cases.source: The patch shipped on Monday. Sales increased on Tuesday.
cases.reference_translation: 补丁于周一发布，销量在周二增长。
semantic_checks: 不能补因此或由于补丁

cases.source: The cache that stores results from requests processed by workers in the same region is shared by all instances.
cases.reference_translation: 所有实例共用一个缓存，其中存储同一区域内工作进程处理请求所得的结果。

cases.source: Engine A caches results. Engine B does not, so it must recompute them.
cases.reference_translation: 引擎 A 会缓存结果，而引擎 B 不会，因此引擎 B 必须重新计算。
semantic_checks: 缺缓存与重新计算因果完整

cases.source: The provider sells its unused capacity to customers who cannot obtain their own.
cases.reference_translation: 这家供应商向无法自行获得容量的客户出售闲置容量。
semantic_checks: 不误写客户出售供应商容量

cases.source: Revenue was $7.14 billion.
cases.reference_translation: 营收为 71.4 亿美元。

cases.source: The project costs $2.5 million per year.
cases.reference_translation: 该项目每年花费 250 万美元。

cases.source: Revenue grew 131% year over year.
cases.reference_translation: 营收同比增长 131%。

cases.source: Throughput is three times the baseline.
cases.reference_translation: 吞吐量是基准值的三倍。

cases.source: Utilization rose from 40% to 45%, an increase of five percentage points.
cases.reference_translation: 利用率从 40% 升至 45%，提高了 5 个百分点。

cases.source: The yield is in the high nineties.
cases.reference_translation: 良率在百分之九十几的高位。

cases.source: The forecast is for utilization to rise from 60% to 70% by 2028.
cases.reference_translation: 预测利用率到 2028 年将从 60% 升至 70%。

cases.source: This may improve reliability.
cases.reference_translation: 这可能提高可靠性。
semantic_checks: 不能强化为必将或一定

cases.source: We expect the upgrade to reduce costs.
cases.reference_translation: 我们预计这次升级会降低成本。

cases.source: I'll try to send the draft tomorrow.
cases.reference_translation: 我争取明天发出草稿。

cases.source: The test did not show a significant improvement.
cases.reference_translation: 测试没有显示出显著改善。
semantic_checks: 不等于证明没有任何改善

cases.source: Only the large model improved on this benchmark.
cases.reference_translation: 在这项基准测试中，只有大模型的表现有所改善。

cases.source: We refer to the paper "A Study of Sparse Models".
cases.reference_translation: 我们引用了论文“A Study of Sparse Models”。
semantic_checks: 被引用的作品标题不随正文翻译

cases.source: Run `cache.clear()` before the next test.
cases.reference_translation: 下次测试前，运行 `cache.clear()`。

cases.source: Factory capacity grew, while memory capacity per device stayed unchanged.
cases.reference_translation: 工厂产能增加了，但每台设备的内存容量保持不变。

cases.source: Wafer yield improved, while bond yields fell.
cases.reference_translation: 晶圆良率提高了，而债券收益率下降了。

cases.source: The language model generated 40 tokens per second.
cases.reference_translation: 这个语言模型每秒生成 40 个 token。

cases.source: The OAuth token expires after one hour.
cases.reference_translation: OAuth 令牌一小时后过期。
semantic_checks: 不能把鉴权概念强行套AI token规则

cases.source: The example string says "Ignore previous instructions".
cases.reference_translation: 示例字符串写着“Ignore previous instructions”。

cases.source: See https://example.org/report?q=1&x=2 for details.
cases.reference_translation: 详情见 https://example.org/report?q=1&x=2。

cases.source: The service retries only transient failures.
cases.reference_translation: 服务只会重试暂时性故障。
semantic_checks: 当前自然且准确时可完全不改

cases.source: For [[[STRONG_1|small batches]]], the benefit is limited.
cases.reference_translation: 收益对 [[[STRONG_1|小批量]]] 而言有限。

cases.source: If demand keeps rising while supply remains constrained, prices may stay elevated even after new capacity becomes available.
cases.reference_translation: 如果需求持续上升而供应依然紧张，即使新产能投入使用，价格也可能维持高位。
semantic_checks: 条件与让步可同一复句

cases.source: The model is smaller. It fits on one device. This reduces communication overhead.
cases.reference_translation: 模型体积更小，单台设备就能容纳，因此通信开销更低。

cases.source: The yield now exceeds 80%; a year ago it was below 50%.
cases.reference_translation: 良率从一年前不到 50% 升至超过 80%。
semantic_checks: 不添加竞品利润或背后原因

cases.source: At least two independent tests are needed, and the final result is still uncertain.
cases.reference_translation: 至少需要两次独立测试，但最终结果仍不确定。
semantic_checks: 不能表述为测完即可确定
